commonStagingEnvelope.fingerprintInput: stable JSON of the seven required fields plus commonStagingSha256 as stagingSha256
commonStagingEnvelope.manifestHashCompatibility: projection_manifest_sha256 retains the immutable migration-458 algorithm and excludes this envelope; envelope drift is verified independently by upstream_envelope_sha256

sourceCoveragePolicy: every row of one COMPLETE common staging run is decided exactly once as PROJECT, QUARANTINE, or IGNORE

projectionPolicy.identity: the projector emits GENERATED or REUSED identity mode plus a stable SHA-256 identity locator, target object type and target source namespace; WBS742 allocates or reuses the concrete CUID2 target PK atomically
projectionPolicy.payload: only non-identity target columns declared by the frozen target schema are emitted as canonical typed JSON; CHAR(8) PK/FK values and audit columns are never embedded; every value carries a SOURCE_EXACT, SOURCE_ABSENT, APPROVED_CATALOG, EXPLICIT_RULE, DERIVED_INDEX, or CONSTANT_CONTRACT origin; SOURCE_EXACT and SOURCE_ABSENT columns carry an RFC 6901 sourceBindings pointer and are checked against the locked Common Staging payload_json
projectionPolicy.provenance: APPROVED_CATALOG requires CATALOG_PROVENANCE, EXPLICIT_RULE requires RULE_PROVENANCE, and each requires an immutable approval SHA-256
projectionPolicy.references: every target CHAR(8) identity column other than the row PK is represented by the exact FK target table/PK/source-locator binding declared by the object data model contract
projectionPolicy.displayName: preserved as data only and never used alone as identity or an automatic join key
projectionPolicy.unresolved: unknown, missing, ambiguous, cross-owner, type-drift, or payload-drift records are losslessly quarantined; values are never guessed
projectionPolicy.replay: same COMPLETE staging run, catalog version, manifest and target schema returns the existing COMPLETE run with zero writes; any stored parity mismatch fails closed

furniture.definitionResolution: approved immutable catalog-index or approved provenance-bearing historical/legacy-recovered crosswalk only
furniture.purchasePriceAndEnhancement: required explicit typed projection; never default or derive from exp/rate
furniture.rate: draw probability evidence only; never charm_per_enhancement

miniPet.ownedOccurrenceResolution: all 3890 sealed occurrences require an approved exact occurrence-locator crosswalk, including display-exact candidates
miniPet.sourceRole: MINI_PET_BAG and MINI_PET_EQUIPPED are explicit Common Staging record_kind values and must equal projection sourceRole; display or array proximity never selects the role
miniPet.definitionBalance: sale_price, max_enhancement_level, active_flag and enhancement rule gains/probability/cost require explicit approved typed projections

titles.definitionPrice: base_sale_price comes only from approved definition projection
titles.occurrencePrice: acquisition_price preserves exact list[].price and may be null only when the occurrence source is genuinely absent; never copy definition price
titles.selection: title.num is one-based; null or zero means no selection; out-of-range selection is quarantined

equipment.durability: preserve an available lossless source value; missing durability requires an explicitly approved zero rule or quarantine

transactionBoundary: one complete manifest is preflighted and committed atomically after locking its COMPLETE common staging run
